title: On the spectral radius of operator tuples
summary: In recent work, Shalit and Shamovich associated to every operator space structure $\mathcal{E}$ on $\mathbb{C}^d$ a spectral radius function $ρ_{\mathcal{E}}$ on $d$-tuples of operators. The main goal of this paper is to elucidate how this spectral radius depends on the operator space structure. Let $V = (\mathbb{C}^d, \|\cdot\|_V)$ be a normed space and let $\mathcal{E}$ be a quantization of $V$.
